This persistent home-anchoring suppresses retail-recreation mobility through reduced outdoor activity tolerance and habit formation around domestic routines, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean over the last 28 days, or RESIDENTIAL mobility begins to decline week-on-week.

This behavioral reorientation toward necessity-driven mobility reduces spillover retail-recreation visits that historically accompany grocery shopping, causing RETAIL_REC to remain depressed or decline further.
